---
name: blog-post-tagger
description: >-
  Suggest three to five topic tags for one blog post from its text. Use when an agent
  must "tag this post" or "pick categories for the blog".
license: MIT
metadata:
  author: example
  version: "1.1.0"
  joystream-skill-kind: instruction
---

# Purpose

Give the editor a short list of tags so each post lands in the right blog category.

# Inputs

- **post_url** (string, required): the post, for example https://example.com/blog/launch-week.
- **known_tags** (array, optional): tags the blog already uses.

# Reasoning Flow

1. Download the post from `post_url` and read its title and body.
2. Pick three to five tags from the main topics of the post.
3. Prefer tags from `known_tags` when one fits.

# Output

- `tags`: three to five lowercase tags.
